title.narrative: Education in Emergencies and early recovery support for children in Gaza Strip and West Bank

description.narrative: UNESCO will support the implementation of inclusive education to ensure the active participation and achievement in school of all learners regardless of their differences and abilities. UNESCO will follow a whole school approach to ensure the involvement of all members of a school community (i.e. students, staff, parents and care givers, community members) and seek to include all areas of school life. In addition, UNESCO will address the emotional, social, and psychological needs of students with a focus on using UNESCO’s unique approach in integrating culture into MHPSS by leveraging arts, heritage, and cultural practices. Adding to the above, support learning and wellbeing of students, grade 1-4, in TLSs using games, art, music, ensuring the inclusion of children with various educational needs in the Temporary Learning Spaces (TLSs).
